Diverse friendships
Cultural diversity in friendships is important ((because)) it helps us understand different perspectives and traditions. ((By)) engaging with friends from different cultures, we learn about their customs and appreciate their uniqueness. It also breaks down stereotypes and promotes unity. ((So)) through friendships across cultures, we exchange knowledge and skills.
